_note: Authored attachment footprints: per-muscle vertex index lists, resolved from a handful of anatomical seeds by geodesic growth over the mesh. Only muscles listed here are reassigned; every other muscle keeps the solver's own nearest-bone assignment, deliberately -- five attempts to INFER footprints from geometry each measured worse than that baseline, because these muscles wrap the humerus and contact is not attachment. The two pectoral heads use LINE seeds along the sternal border, the costal cartilages and the clavicle, because those origins are lines and a single centroid seed under-specified them. Pectoralis major STERNAL head is deliberately absent. Its footprint was shipped once and measured worse on the reported defect: vertices projecting above the clavicle's upper border in the reaching pose went 1,080 -> 3,290 with a max overshoot of 4.85 -> 8.50 units. Removing it gives 746 / 3.09, better than the pre-footprint baseline. Its origin is a long line along the sternal border and costal cartilages and its seeds snap 5.5 units off the mesh, so the footprint is too imprecise to help; it also has 1,132 vertices with no geodesic path to either attachment.
